# WallerSketch asset recipes (format "wallersketch-asset" v1)

WallerSketch composes cocktail-table installations in 3D: tables, presentoirs (risers), fabrics that drape automatically, glasses, prepared cocktails and decor. You create assets by writing JSON recipes. Lengths are in centimetres, glass outlines in millimetres, colours are "#rrggbb". Reply with a JSON object { "recipes": [ ... ] } inside a ```json block. Every recipe needs "kind" and "name".

## Kinds
- table: { kind:"table", name, shape:"rect"|"round"|"highboy", width_cm, depth_cm (rect only), height_cm (30–130, default 75), top?:Surface, legs?:Surface }
- presentoir: a riser or display stand that glasses stand on; maximum height 50 cm. { kind:"presentoir", name, shape:"rect"|"round"|"taper"|"tiers", width_cm, depth_cm, height_cm, steps? (tiers: 2–6 stepped levels, front lowest), surface?:Surface }
- fabric: { kind:"fabric", name, shape:"rect"|"round", width_cm, depth_cm, color, material:"satin"|"sequins"|"linen"|"velvet"|"cotton" }. Fabrics drape by physics over the table (and optionally risers) where they are placed; size decides the drop.
- glass: { kind:"glass", name, profile_mm:[[radius,height],...] outer outline from the centre of the foot (height 0) up to the rim, heights increasing; bowl_mm: height of the inner bottom where liquid starts; wall_mm?: 0.6–6; plastic?: boolean }
- cocktail: { kind:"cocktail", name, glass: one of "highball", "collins", "tumbler", "flute", "stemless-flute", "coupe", "martini", "wine", "goblet", "margarita", "hurricane", "shot", "bubble-cup" or a full glass object, colors:[bottom…surface] (gradient; set layered:true for distinct bands), fill: 0.2–1, ice: 0–8, garnish:[…], crystal?: boolean (cut-crystal glass) }
  garnish values: mint (Menthe), lime-wheel (Rondelle citron vert), lime-inside (Citron vert dans le verre), lime-wedge (Quartier citron vert), lemon-wheel (Rondelle citron), orange-wheel (Rondelle orange), orange-peel (Zeste), cherry (Cerise), strawberry (Fraise), strawberry-rim (Fraise sur le bord), berries-skewer (Brochette de fruits), raspberries (Framboises), blueberries (Myrtilles), mango (Mangue), pineapple (Ananas), rock-candy (Bâton de sucre), gypsophila (Gypsophile), bow (Nœud), salt-rim (Bord sel), pink-rim (Bord sucre rose), coffee-beans (Grains de café), pearls (Perles de tapioca), big-ice (Gros glaçon), gold-stirrer (Touilleur doré), straw-black (Paille noire), straw-paper (Paille rayée), straw-wide (Paille large), dome (Couvercle), gold-rim (Liseré or), sugar-rim (Bord sucre)
- decor: recolour or resize a catalogue decor piece. { kind:"decor", name, base:<decor ref>, colors?:{part:color}, size_cm?:{width,height,depth} }
- composition: a ready arrangement. { kind:"composition", name, items:[{ asset:<catalogue ref or an inline recipe>, x_cm, z_cm, rotation_deg?, on?:<index of an earlier item it stands on> }] }. x to the right, z towards the guests; heights are computed (objects sit on what is under them).

Surface = { color, finish?:"matte"|"satin"|"gloss"|"mirror"|"brass", texture?:"wood"|"marble", lit?:boolean (lit acrylic) }

## Catalogue refs
- tables: rect-120 (Table 120 × 60), rect-180 (Table 180 × 75), rect-240 (Banquet 240 × 80), rect-300 (Buffet 300 × 90), square-90 (Carrée 90), round-80 (Ronde Ø 80), round-120 (Ronde Ø 120), round-150 (Ronde Ø 150), highboy-70 (Mange-debout Ø 70)
- presentoirs: cube-20 (Cube 20), cube-30 (Cube 30), cube-40 (Cube 40), cube-50 (Cube 50), block-60 (Pavé 60 × 30), block-80 (Pavé 80 × 40), step-100 (Marche 100 × 30), column-50 (Colonne 30 × 50), cyl-20 (Cylindre Ø 20), cyl-30 (Cylindre Ø 30), cyl-40 (Cylindre Ø 40), disc-50 (Plateau Ø 50), taper-30 (Trapèze 30), taper-45 (Trapèze 45), tiers-3 (Gradins 3 niveaux), tiers-4-lit (Gradins lumineux 4 niveaux), tiers-2-gold (Gradins laiton 2 niveaux), tray-gold (Plateau miroir doré Ø 45), tray-silver (Plateau miroir argent 60 × 40), plinth-marble (Socle marbre noir 40)
- fabrics: cloth-320 (Nappe 320 × 180), cloth-400 (Nappe 400 × 220), cloth-240 (Nappe 240 × 150), cloth-round-280 (Nappe ronde Ø 280), cloth-round-200 (Nappe ronde Ø 200), cloth-sequin-320 (Nappe paillettes 320 × 180), cloth-velvet-300 (Nappe velours 300 × 180), runner-300 (Chemin de table 300 × 40), drape-150 (Drapé 150 × 150), drape-100 (Drapé 100 × 100)
- cocktails: mojito (Mojito classique), mojito-mango (Mojito mangue), sunrise (Sunrise), blue-lagoon (Blue Lagoon), sunrise-flute (Sunrise flûte), mojito-flute (Mojito flûte), blue-raspberry (Framboise bleue), pink-litchi (Rose pétillant), strawberry-passion (Fraise passion), bubble-tea (Bubble Tea), pina-colada (Piña colada), margarita (Margarita), cosmopolitan (Cosmopolitan), espresso-martini (Espresso martini), aperol-spritz (Spritz), strawberry-daiquiri (Daïquiri fraise), pink-lemonade (Limonade rose), red-punch (Punch fruits rouges), old-fashioned (Old fashioned), peach-tea (Thé glacé pêche), champagne (Champagne), kir-royal (Kir royal), b52 (B-52)
- empty glasses: glass-highball (Highball), glass-collins (Collins), glass-tumbler (Tumbler), glass-flute (Flûte), glass-stemless-flute (Flûte sans pied), glass-coupe (Coupe), glass-martini (Martini), glass-wine (Verre à vin), glass-goblet (Ballon), glass-margarita (Margarita), glass-hurricane (Hurricane), glass-shot (Shot), glass-bubble-cup (Gobelet bubble tea)
- decor: bouquet-hydrangea (Hortensias blancs), bouquet-peony (Pivoines poudrées), bouquet-rose (Roses orangées), gypsophila (Gypsophile), garland (Guirlande eucalyptus), dispenser (Fontaine à boisson), straw-holder (Pot à pailles), napkin-box (Boîte à serviettes), sign-a5 (Chevalet A5), frame-a3 (Cadre menu A3), candle (Photophore), tower-5 (Pyramide de coupes 5 étages), tower-3 (Pyramide de coupes 3 étages), candelabra (Chandelier 5 branches), ice-bucket (Seau à champagne), backdrop-curtain (Rideau plissé), backdrop-wall (Mur), backdrop-arch (Arche)

## Example
```json
{ "recipes": [
  { "kind": "cocktail", "name": "Passion rose", "glass": "coupe", "colors": ["#d8336a", "#f7b2c4"], "fill": 0.85, "garnish": ["gold-rim", "raspberries"] },
  { "kind": "presentoir", "name": "Gradins miroir", "shape": "tiers", "steps": 3, "width_cm": 80, "depth_cm": 45, "height_cm": 36, "surface": { "color": "#d9dcdf", "finish": "mirror" } }
] }
```
